Maruti Sales Breakup Oct 2026 - WagonR, Brezza, Baleno, Dzire, Ertiga, Fronx, Swift, Victoris

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Maruti Suzuki’s October 2026 sales rose by 36,066 units from 1,76,318 units a year earlier.
  • The company also sold 30,546 more cars than it did in September 2026, when volumes stood at 1,81,838 units.
  • WagonR moved to the top of Maruti’s sales chart, overtaking September leader Baleno, while Brezza delivered the biggest volume gain in the lineup both year-on-year and month-on-month.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Maruti Suzuki’s October 2026 sales rose by 36,066 units from 1,76,318 units a year earlier. The company also sold 30,546 more cars than it did in September 2026, when volumes stood at 1,81,838 units. WagonR moved to the top of Maruti’s sales chart, overtaking September leader Baleno, while Brezza delivered the biggest volume gain in the lineup both year-on-year and month-on-month.

📌 The Core Development

WagonR led with 23,747 units, up 25.18% from 18,970 units in October last year and 26.08% from 18,835 units in September. It accounted for 11.18% of Maruti’s October sales and finished 1,311 units ahead of Brezza. The SUV took second place with 22,436 units, up 85.85% YoY and 43.04% MoM. Brezza alone contributed 10,364 units to Maruti’s year-on-year gain, accounting for nearly 29% of the increase.

Baleno placed third with 20,919 units. Sales were up 23.98% YoY, but fell 17.62% from September’s 25,392 units, making it the only Maruti model to record a month-on-month decline. Dzire and Ertiga were separated by just eight units. Dzire finished fourth with 20,649 units, down 0.68% YoY and up 16.31% MoM, while Ertiga sold 20,641 units, up 2.76% YoY and 22.06% MoM.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Fronx rounded out the six models above 20,000 units, with 20,014 units sold, up 17.71% YoY and 3.80% MoM. Facelifted Fronx has been spied ahead of launch in early 2027. Together, the top six accounted for 1,28,406 units, or just over 60% of Maruti’s October volumes. Swift followed with 18,866 units, up 21.39% YoY and 8.43% MoM.

Victoris ranked eighth with 16,792 units, up 24.42% YoY and 28.08% MoM. It outsold Grand Vitara by 5,592 units. Eeco followed with 13,720 units, up 1.35% YoY and 24.28% MoM. Alto took tenth place with 11,523 units, up 85.56% from 6,210 units a year earlier and 14.95% from September. Its gain of 5,313 units was the second-largest YoY increase in the lineup, behind Brezza.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

Grand Vitara sold 11,200 units, up 7.60% YoY and 31.56% MoM. Celerio recorded the strongest year-on-year percentage growth, rising 248.49% from 1,322 units to 4,607 units. It also grew 89.74% over September. XL6 registered 3,785 units, up 4.82% YoY and 16.43% MoM.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Maruti eVitara sales reached 2,015 units, up 50.15% from 1,342 units in September. The electric SUV added 673 units month-on-month and accounted for 0.95% of Maruti’s October volumes. There were no e Vitara sales in the October 2025 comparison.

Jimny followed with 601 units, up 1.52% YoY and 10.48% MoM. S-Presso recovered from just 55 units in September to 566 units in October, though volumes remained well below the 2,857 units sold a year earlier. Invicto recorded 303 units, up from 301 units last October and 272 units in September. Ignis has been discontinued.
